test_vectors: Exact grammar and root aliases agree with prior-wave parse output, including escaped punctuation, empty keys, Unicode, repeated indices, and u32::MAX indices.
Bare, dot, and bracket wildcards compose; quoted and escaped stars remain literal, while embedded unescaped stars are invalid.
Equality filters support all scalar literals, permitted ASCII whitespace, JSON escapes, surrogate pairs, escaped key punctuation, and exact numeric spelling.
Basic grammar error codes, sources, and byte offsets agree with the prior parser; extension truncations report UnexpectedEof at input end.
Recursive descent, negative indices, unions, slices, nested predicate paths, non-equality operators, expressions, function calls, regexes, and container literals reject as UnsupportedSchemaFeature.
Malformed punctuation, disallowed whitespace, invalid escapes, controls, and invalid filter numbers produce deterministic path errors, including explicit byte-offset assertions.

Programmatic numeric literals accept strict JSON spelling without conversion and reject empty, truncated, signed-plus, leading-zero, hexadecimal, nonfinite, underscored, whitespace-padded, and compound text.
Compilation owns independent copies, retains PathLimits, and applies inclusive segment, decoded-key, filter-string, and numeric-spelling bounds; zero limits remain real bounds.
Textual path limits count source UTF-8 bytes before parsing; decoded string limits count decoded UTF-8 bytes, including escaped Unicode.
Wildcards select immediate object values and array elements in starting-offset order, never keys or recursive descendants; mismatched container types and out-of-range indices produce no matches.

Filter matching distinguishes null, booleans, strings, numbers, missing members, and containers; lexical numbers retain negative zero, decimal/exponent spelling, huge exponents, and integers beyond exact floating-point precision.
Decoded predicate keys and string values compare UTF-8 bytes without Unicode normalization, including surrogate pairs, escaped controls, and programmatic empty keys.
Only the first immediate predicate member counts, including equivalent decoded duplicate key spellings and container-valued first occurrences; canonical duplicate-key rejection remains effective.
Delayed and nested filters roll back provisional descendants correctly across earlier values, missing predicates, rejected siblings, and outer predicate failure.
Terminal filters retain complete object spans, container delimiters, internal whitespace, and string escape spelling; duplicate exact-key matches remain distinct by byte offset.

Raw and cooked results retain the complete original payload and tagged decoded arena after cloning and owner destruction, for both payload storage variants; borrowed pointer and out-of-range accessor assertions are included.

All root value kinds exclude outer whitespace. Strict mode reaches syntax completion; query mode establishes all matches within the complete root, retains trailing bytes, and conservatively reports false validation status.

Visit accounting includes every event and every matching prefix candidate. Exact inclusive boundaries, zero budgets, unmatched events, provisional filter work, current-byte errors, and u32::MAX counter exhaustion are asserted.
Match ceilings reject overflow without truncation; zero-result limits allow absent paths and candidates discarded by failed filters.
Unique exact extension queries agree with prior-wave selector spans, decoded references, raw views, cooked strings, decoded arenas, and strict validation flags.

Syntax failures propagate unchanged from direct cursor traversal, including malformed containers, numbers, UTF-8, escapes, surrogates, duplicate keys, truncation, and trailing content after earlier matches.
Canonical payload, depth, array-item, object-field, string-byte, number-digit, and decoded-arena limits accept exact boundaries and reject the next unit.
Deterministic stress vectors cover 64 nested wildcard selectors and 128 sibling objects with alternating late filter predicates.
